title: Bone Broth
quick_recipe:
- 10 pounds beef bones
- 4 large carrots (chopped into 2-inch pieces)
- 2 medium onions (quartered)
- 2 whole heads garlic (halved crosswise)
- 6 stalks celery (cut into 2-inch pieces)
- 4 bay leaves
- 1/4 cup black peppercorns
- 4 whole star anise (optional)
- 2 whole cinnamon sticks (optional)
- 2 tablespoon apple cider vinegar

- Cover the bones with cold water, boil 15–20 minutes, then drain and rinse.
- Roast the bones and vegetables at 450 degrees for 30 minutes. Toss and roast 15–30 minutes more.
- Cover with water. Add the bay leaves, peppercorns, star anise, cinnamon, and vinegar.
- Simmer with the lid ajar at least 8–12 hours, up to 24. Keep everything submerged.
- Strain, cool, and lift off the fat.
- Refrigerate about 5 days, or freeze up to 6 months.

title: Chanko Nabe
quick_recipe:
For the Chicken Meatballs
- 1/2 lb ground chicken
- 1/2 large egg (50 g each w/o shell) (beaten)
- 1 green onion/scallion
- 2 inches fresh ginger
- 2 tsp soy sauce
- 6 Tbsp panko (Japanese breadcrumbs)
- 1 Tbsp cornstarch
For the Broth
- 6 cups chicken stock/broth (for vegan/vegetarian, use vegetable broth or Vegan Dashi)
- 1/4 cup sake
- 1/3 cup mirin
- 2 cloves garlic (crushed)
- 4 inches fresh ginger
- 1/2 cup white miso
For the Stew
- chicken meatballs (see ingredients above)
- 4 boneless, skinless chicken thighs
- 1 1/2 lb cod fillet
- 8 shrimp
- 14 oz medium-firm tofu (momen dofu)
- 6 oz thinly-sliced pork belly (optional)
- 1/2 head napa cabbage
- 2 inches carrot
- 2 Tokyo negi (long green onion)
- 6 green onions/scallions
- 4–6 shiitake mushrooms
For Serving
- ponzu (or make my Homemade Ponzu recipe)
- sesame dipping sauce (goma dare)
- 4 servings cooked Japanese short-grain rice (or precooked udon / ramen noodles; for the final course)

- Mix the chicken, egg, scallion, ginger, soy sauce, panko, and cornstarch. Roll into 1-inch meatballs.
- Cut the chicken, cod, tofu, pork, cabbage, carrot, negi, scallions, and mushrooms into bite-size pieces. Peel the shrimp.
- Simmer the stock, sake, mirin, garlic, and ginger.
- Dissolve the miso in a little broth, stir it back in, and take the pot off the heat before it boils.
- Simmer the fish, tofu, cabbage, negi, carrots, and mushrooms about 10 minutes.
- Add the meatballs and remaining meat and vegetables. Simmer about 10 minutes more.
- Serve with ponzu or sesame sauce. Finish the broth with rice or noodles for 2–3 minutes.

- 1 1/2 tablespoons brown sugar
- pinch cloves, 1/2 teaspoon thyme, pinch cayenne, salt and pepper
- 4 hamburger buns

- Cook the carrots in the oil 5 minutes. Add the onion and celery for 5 minutes more, then the garlic for 30 seconds
- Brown the beef. Leave about 1 tablespoon of fat
- Stir in the ketchup, tomato sauce, Worcestershire, vinegar, brown sugar, and spices
- Simmer on medium-low for 10 minutes
- Serve on the buns

title: Sourdough Bread
quick_recipe:
- 1/2 cup active starter
- 1 1/2 cups water
- 4 cups flour
- 2 teaspoons salt

Baked
- Mix the starter, water, and flour. Rest 30 minutes
- Add the salt. Fold the dough every 30 minutes for 2 hours
- Rise until puffy, about 4–8 hours
- Shape, then refrigerate overnight
- Oven: 450 degrees, in a covered pot
- Time: 20 minutes covered, then 20–25 minutes uncovered

title: Sourdough Brioche
quick_recipe:
- 1/2 cup active starter
- 1/3 cup milk
- 3 eggs
- 1/4 cup sugar
- 3 cups flour
- 1 teaspoon salt
- 1/2 cup soft butter

Baked
- Mix everything except the butter. Knead in the butter a little at a time
- Rise until doubled, 4–8 hours
- Shape into a loaf. Rise until puffy
- Oven: 350 degrees
- Time: 30–35 minutes

title: Sourdough French Toast
quick_recipe:
- 4 slices sourdough bread
- 4 eggs
- 1 cup ( 240 ml) whole milk
- 1/4 cup (56 grams) brown sugar (See Note 2)
- 3 teaspoons vanilla extract
- 1/2 teaspoon ground cinnamon
- salt
- 1/2 ounce ( 1 tablespoon/ 15 grams) unsalted butter

- Whisk the eggs, milk, brown sugar, vanilla, cinnamon, and salt.
- Soak the bread on both sides.
- Cook in butter over medium-low, about 3 minutes, then 2 minutes on the other side.
- Hold the finished slices in a 195 degree oven while you cook the rest.

title: Spinach Patties
quick_recipe:
- 16 1/2 ounces spinach
- 4 ounces goat cheese or feta
- 2 eggs
- 1/2 cup matzo meal
- 1/2 teaspoon salt
- 1/2 teaspoon pepper
- oil, for frying
- 4 tablespoons olive oil
- 1 1/2 cups chicken stock
- juice of 2 lemons
- 7 garlic cloves, minced
- 3 bunches cilantro

- Steam the spinach until wilted. Drain and chop
- Mix with the cheese, eggs, matzo meal, salt, and pepper
- Fry patties in a little oil over medium-high until browned
- Simmer the olive oil, stock, lemon juice, garlic, and cilantro, and spoon it over the patties

title: Stuffing
quick_recipe:
- 1 loaf bread, cubed and dried
- 1/2 cup butter
- 1 onion, chopped
- 3 ribs celery, chopped
- 2 teaspoons sage
- 1 teaspoon thyme
- 2 cups broth
- salt and pepper

Baked
- Cook the onion and celery in the butter. Stir in the herbs
- Toss with the bread and broth
- Oven: 375 degrees
- Time: 30–35 minutes, until browned

title: Sweet Potato and Black Bean Tacos (Vegan)
quick_recipe:
- 2 sweet potatoes, cubed
- 1 tablespoon olive oil
- 1 teaspoon chili powder
- salt
- 1 can black beans, drained
- 8 tortillas
- cabbage, lime, and avocado

Baked
- Toss the sweet potatoes with oil, chili powder, and salt
- Oven: 425 degrees
- Time: 25 minutes
- Warm the beans
- Fill the tortillas with the potatoes, beans, cabbage, lime, and avocado
note: from Mrs. Alcorn: I do not make the avocado-pepita dip too much work for me.  I just cut up avocados to add to the tacos.

title: Sweet Potato Burrito Bowl (Vegan)
quick_recipe:
- 2 sweet potatoes, cubed
- 1 tablespoon olive oil
- 1 teaspoon cumin
- salt
- 2 cups cooked rice
- 1 can black beans, drained
- salsa
- lime

Baked
- Toss the sweet potatoes with oil, cumin, and salt
- Oven: 425 degrees
- Time: 25 minutes
- Bowl the rice, beans, and sweet potatoes
- Top with salsa and lime

title: Tacos (Vegan)
quick_recipe:
- 1 1/2 cups cooked beans (black, kidney, pinto, white beans, or combination)
- 1 cup fire-roasted tomatoes
- 1/2 cup cooked bulgur (or 1/4 cup uncooked)
- tablespoon taco seasoning
- 6 corn tortillas (oil-free)
- diced veggies (lettuce, tomato, onions, cilantro)
- 1 cup salsa (optional)
- vegan cheese sauce (optional)
- chipotle sauce (optional)

- Rinse canned beans.
- Heat the beans, tomatoes, bulgur, and taco seasoning. If the bulgur is raw, add 1/2 cup water and cook until tender.
- Chop the vegetables.
- Fill the tortillas and add salsa or sauce.
- For shells, drape the tortillas over the oven rack. Oven: 400 degrees. Time: 5–7 minutes.

title: Taqueria Style Pickled Jalapeños
quick_recipe:
- 8 jalapeños, sliced
- 1/2 onion, sliced
- 1 carrot, sliced
- 1 cup vinegar
- 1 cup water
- 1 tablespoon salt
- 1 teaspoon oregano
- 1 tablespoon oil

- Sear the jalapeños in the oil
- Add the onion, carrot, vinegar, water, salt, and oregano
- Simmer 5 minutes
- Cool and refrigerate

title: Tater Tots
quick_recipe:

- 1 teaspoon salt
- 1 tablespoon oil

Baked
- Grate the potatoes and squeeze out the water
- Toss with salt and oil. Form into tots
- Oven: 425 degrees
- Time: 20–25 minutes, flip halfway

title: Tofu
quick_recipe:
Preparation:
- Press tofu hard (minimum of 20–30 minutes)
  - More water removed = more crisp.
- Place tofu on a plain baking sheet.
- Sprinkle tofu with cornstarch and toss gently until lightly coated.
- Drizzle ~½–1 tsp of olive oil on a baking sheet and spread thin.
  - Oil should coat the baking sheet, not the tofu.
Bake in Oven:
- Oven: 425 degrees
- Time: 30 minutes

title: Yellow Mustard
quick_recipe:
- 1/2 cup mustard powder
- 1/2 cup water
- 1/4 cup vinegar
- 1/2 teaspoon turmeric
- 1/2 teaspoon salt
- 1 teaspoon honey, optional

- Stir the mustard powder and water. Rest 10 minutes
- Add the vinegar, turmeric, salt, and honey
- Simmer a few minutes until thick
- Cool. It mellows in the fridge

- 8 blackberries
